info.description: FEAT-153 ADR-0019. Not a production release. x-utf8-max-bytes is an additional UTF-8 byte bound. Internal API/Coze paths use the same payload source but distinct credentials; editor sessions exist only at API/native boundary.

ServiceBearer.description: Distinct API-to-Coze K_AC, fixed run epoch and principal/resource checks. Never K_NA or browser E.

Workflow.description: Coze-owned graph and revision. Canvas is native JSON text; safe incomplete drafts may be saved. IDs are opaque strings, including decimal Coze IDs, never JS numbers.

state.description: Actual engine status; new values stay visible and never imply success.

version.description: Version registered by this operation: the newly committed version for publish, or the selected published version for a release run. Omitted for create, save, and debug test operations; never copies Workflow.published_version as ambient resource metadata.

OperationReceipt.description: Dispatch receipt, not engine status. completed identifies committed resource/execution registration, not successful workflow execution.

secret.description: Native/API only. Never serialize this response to renderer, URL, log or MessageChannel.

EditorExchangeInput.description: Native generates write operation IDs. operation_id input is only a read_operation lookup. No actor, secret, URL, headers or arbitrary command.

WorkflowSummary.description: Bounded list summary; read the detail endpoint for full content.

state.description: Actual engine status; new values stay visible and never imply success.

RunSummary.description: Bounded list summary; read the detail endpoint for full content.

x-private-adapter.description: Derived private provider surface. API validates E, Coze validates distinct K_AC and fixed scope/epoch; sessions are API-owned.
